description_en: Queries the settlement bills of a user for a specific billing cycle. Supports domestic accounts with more than 50,000 bill entries
description_zh: 查询用户某个账期内的结算账单。支持账单条目超过50000条的国内账号
name: QuerySettleBill

parameters.help_en: The billing cycle, in the format of YYYY-MM
parameters.name: billing_cycle

parameters.help_en:
The type. Valid values:
SubscriptionOrder: prepaid order
PayAsYouGoBill: pay-as-you-go bill
Refund: refund bill
Adjustment: adjustment bill
parameters.help_zh:
类型。取值：
SubscriptionOrder 预付费订单
PayAsYouGoBill 后付费账单
Refund 退款账单
Adjustment 调账账单
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The subscription type. Valid values:
Subscription: subscription
PayAsYouGo: pay-as-you-go
This parameter must be used together with the ProductCode parameter
parameters.help_zh:
订阅类型。取值：
Subscription 预付费
PayAsYouGo 后付费
必须和ProductCode参数一起使用
parameters.name: subscription_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to filter based on whether the original price (PretaxGrossAmount) is 0. Default value: false (compatible with existing logic). Valid values:
true: Yes.
false: No
parameters.help_zh:
根据原价（PretaxGrossAmount）是否为0做过滤，默认为否（兼容现有逻辑）。
true：是。
false：否
parameters.name: is_hide_zero_charge

parameters.help_en: The token that marks the position from which the next query starts. Leave this parameter empty to start from the beginning
parameters.help_zh: 用来标记当前开始读取的位置，置空表示从头开始
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of data records to read in this request. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 300
parameters.help_zh: 本次读取的最大数据记录数量。默认值：20，最大值：300
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource ownership account. The resource ownership account is the account that actually uses the resource
parameters.help_zh: 资源归属账号的ID，资源归属账号是实际使用资源的账号
parameters.name: bill_owner_id

parameters.help_en: The order ID or bill ID
